reason: 'Sepals lost on ripe fruit' and 'bracts often entirely lost' mean the part is shed. FLOPO already uses PATO:0001730 for a part that falls (FLOPO:0991231 fugacious). 'Paraphyses mostly lost' may mean reduction rather than shedding.
'Scarcely' is a degree qualifier on the existing value accrescent (FLOPO:0991082). It belongs in the record, not in a new term.
Sori or vascular bundles 'in a single row' are arranged in one series: FLOPO:0991090 uniseriate.

label: transversely septate
definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's interior being partitioned by transverse walls (septa) into a series of chambers.
reason: Leaf sheaths, laminae, locules and anthers are divided by cross-walls. PO septum (PO_0000030) is defined as a partition between fused organs, so it does not fit. FLOPO:0991243 septate-nodulose would be a child of this class.
'Without dots' or 'sin puntos' means not punctate.
A primrose scent is a sweet floral fragrance. FLOPO:0991016 is the nearest existing odour value, and a scent named after one species is too specific for its own class.
'Plants stemless' (acaulescent) means no visible stem, which pattern 15 covers as stem absent. FLOPO already has the phenotype class FLOPO_0980080 'whole plant acaulescent', which could be reused.

PATO:0001772 has 'wrapping' as a synonym, and 'sheath wrapped around culms' fits it, with the culm as the 'towards' part (pattern 09). For the passive 'inflorescence wrapped in sheaths', use PATO_0005016 surrounded by.
This is a part (a coloured mark on the perianth), not a quality. Neither PO nor FLOPO has a class for it to serve as a bearer.
The examples mix moss lamina cells partitioned by walls with margins cut into lobes. Without the context of each statement there is no single quality.

label: alete
definition: A shape quality inhering in a spore by virtue of the spore's lacking a laesura (germination scar) on its proximal face.
reason: Alete is the third state beside FLOPO:0991308 trilete and FLOPO:0991343 monolete. It gets the same parent as monolete, PATO:0000052, which monolete was moved to in the 2026-11-15 review.
This is a compound of two margin values, minutely ciliate and minutely toothed, which both hold of the margin. It needs the compound pattern, not a term.

target: docs/annotation-context-patterns.md (compound of two values: glandular PATO_0002117 + nodular PATO_0002125)
reason: A rachis bearing gland-like nodules combines two existing PATO values.
'Disk not free' and 'segments not free to the base' negate FLOPO:0991068 free. Where like parts are meant, this amounts to connate (FLOPO:0991067).
The margin of a fern scale or leaf has saw-like teeth formed by projecting cell ends. The shape is serrate even though its origin differs, and 'pseudo-' does not justify a separate class.
Shagreened means roughened with minute close-set points, like shark skin. FLOPO:0991058 scabrous (rough because of minute stiff projections) covers it.
Mauve is a pale purple, PATO:0001260. 'Tinged' (a partial or weak colour) can be kept as a qualifier in the record.
A blade 'radiately divided to base' is cut into segments that radiate from a common point, which is the definition of FLOPO:0991272.
'Becoming redder inside' or 'redder along the filament lines' compares red (PATO_0000322) between regions or stages. It is a comparison, not a value.
A compound of two shapes, the second being spherical (PATO_0001499). It is a transition between two values, as 'oblong-ovate' is.
The adverb is a fragment of 'acutely acuminate' or 'acutely lanceolate'. The quality is carried by the word it modifies.
This is FLOPO:0991099 cartilaginous, whose definition already names the margin, and the bearer should be leaf margin (PO_0020128).
The corm or pseudobulb is surrounded by (PATO_0005016) sheaths, and the sheaths themselves are scarious. This is a relation to another part that has its own quality.
This is a fragment of a suspended hyphen ('homo- or heterogamous', 'homo- or dimorphic'). The parser should expand it to homogamous (FLOPO:0991220) or monomorphic (FLOPO:0991212) for each statement.
An inframedifixed anther is attached on its back below the middle, so it falls under dorsifixed (FLOPO:0991134). Only 6 statements, too few for a class of its own.
The shape is roughly spherical but uneven, which is an approximate spherical (PATO_0001499) and not a new shape.
Necklace-like is the plain-English form of moniliform, a cylinder constricted at intervals like a string of beads.
This is a relation between two parts ('obscuring the nerves', 'obscuring stems'). Its content is that the other part is inconspicuous, and it is not a quality of this bearer.
The meaning varies: decumbent for plants and stems, bent back for a calyx, lying on the posterior petal for a style. PATO:0001965 reclinate (edges bent down onto the stalk) does not fit.
FLOPO:0991100 reticulate is defined as marked by a network of veins, ridges or walls, which covers a reticulately ridged fruit or pyrene.
